title: Reference object (内核架构改进 D10, D03)
description: The one shape other Workspaces, Apps and Agents keep: where (zone, workspace, entity, selector) and which version. Names, paths and URLs are projections of it (D21). `mode: live` follows the head; `mode: fixed` names a version — `{ epoch, seq }` (same Zone; readable only while a checkpoint or clone retains it, else VERSION_NOT_RETAINED) or `{ content_root, path? }` (content-addressed; valid across Zones). Internal references omit zone and workspace_id. Strong or weak is decided by where the reference lives (inside a Workspace by the reference kind catalogue; across Workspaces always weak, §5.2). Checked by core/tests/schemas.rs; normalized by core/src/value.rs canonical_reference.

zone.description: Zone DID or host; only across Zones.

selector.description: A selector of the frozen catalogue (README, Selectors); absent = the whole entity.

content_root.description: A ContentRoot or entity content object id.

path.description: A path inside the content root (a Folder member, a Surface).

legacy.description: Vocabularies canonical_reference maps onto this shape.

persisted reference.published_channel: live (a published link follows the head, D26)
persisted reference.fixed_revision { source_revision }: refused: a URL query entry's own version (§6.1)

wish input.fixed { rev | hash }: refused: a read-set precondition, not a reference

legacy.URL source: `{ kind: url_query, source_url, query }` is not a reference: an unmaterialized query entry (D12, T4-3)
